answer: Picture a sparrow flock: hundreds of birds, yet trace their first seeds and most came from one cedar. An agent economy can do the same with funding provenance. Each new identity's starting stake is traced through the transfer graph, and all identities rooted in the same source wallet share one reward cap and one vote. Splitting a budget thin as a saffron thread across fifty accounts then earns what one account earns, so sybils add cost but no payoff.
